case.pattern_description: A single rare device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) carries transactions for 28 different cards belonging to unrelated customers inside a 30-day window, 54% of every card that profile has ever been seen with (52 in total). There is no testing sequence, no shared billing region and no single compromised cardholder: the common element is the machine. The bank's model scored the cluster a median of 0.13, so none of it was flagged individually and it is only visible by traversing the device profile out to its neighbouring cards. It affects every cardholder on that device, and fits none of the five documented typologies.
